title: K-injective resolutions
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $R$ a commutative ring, and $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$ the abelian category of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $R_T$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $A^\bullet,I^\bullet,K^\bullet$ be cochain complexes in this category [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Write $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(A,I)$ for the cochain complex of abelian groups whose degree-$n$ group is $\prod_{p\in\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Hom}_{\Mod(T_{\Et},R)}(A^p,I^{p+n})$ and whose differential on a degree-$n$ family $f$ is $d_I\circ f-(-1)^n f\circ d_A$. The complex $I^\bullet$ is *K-injective* if $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(A,I)$ is acyclic for every acyclic $A^\bullet$ [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]. A *K-injective resolution* of $K^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism $K^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] with $I^\bullet$ K-injective. For etale abelian sheaves, take $R=\mathbf Z$.

The definition is the only content of this blueprint node; it has no proof steps and creates no new statements.
